scope: Actual immutable full-target StructuralSampler, 180 original steps times four rank identities; CPU sequential preparation, not a GPU throughput benchmark
command: Stage2 Python: load actual targets.npy, target_offsets.npy, node_moments.npz; StructuralSampler.draw(step,rank,4,track=False) for step in range(180), rank in range(4); time generation and traversal
decision: No net whole-run saving demonstrated by materializing a single-use schedule: preparation still performs every original draw. Do not create duplicate persistent assets. Four-rank on-device static topology and immutable six-feature means are reused. Host endpoints are determined before asynchronous transfers; original RNG, order and receipt are checked by test_sample_indices. Per-rank training overhead is not the sequential four-rank total divided by epochs.
not_claimed: Measured GPU speedup from this CPU experiment
